scope: source delivery only; no hosted activation, no autonomous action, no natural-event acceptance claim

implemented.resolver: services/evolution/approved_baselines.py resolve_member_baseline approves only with: approved registry entry, checksum/tenant/embedded artifact checksum, replication_success True, an admitted replication_proof whose single real_backtest_validation passed with all checks true and numbers equal to evaluation_summary, round_trips > 0, and an authoritative BacktestRunStore run_record (completed, artifact_checksum == member checksum) for that run id. Summary Sharpe above a threshold or a run id in lineage is never treated as a verdict. Missing/failed/foreign proof or no run_record -> explicit no_approved_baseline reason (e.g. backtest_run_binding_unavailable).
implemented.return_basis: member_virtual_book.gate_basis_metrics replays the gate's share-sized cash portfolio per underlying from recorded view directions: signed order_quantity (taken from the checksum-verified member artifact, exposed on the baseline) BUY/SELL orders at the mark, buys cash-capped, commission every fill + sell tax (ETF rate for 00xx), equity from init_cash 100000, daily equity-return Sharpe sqrt(252) ddof=1, aggregate = mean of per-instrument Sharpe and drawdown. Result is member['gate_basis'] on RETURN_BASIS, so compare_member_book yields real sharpe/drawdown deltas. Existing exposure-fraction gross/net blocks and account baselines are unchanged; legacy observations without a recorded direction report member_metric_missing (direction_not_recorded).
implemented.runtime_entry_point: paper_runtime._member_book_snapshot and PersonaStrategyPoolStore default run_record_reader to approved_baselines.backtest_run_record_reader, a read-only reader of the research owner's BacktestRunStore file under the existing ALPHA_REPLICATION_DATA_DIR (no new setting). Unset/absent store or unknown run -> backtest_run_binding_unavailable; no fallback proof.
implemented.pool_entry_point: persona_strategy_pool.py PersonaStrategyPoolStore.member_baselines (read-only, keyed by pool_version, artifact_ref, checksum)

tests: Recorded Taiwan backtest fixtures (recorded_backtest_tw_2330 / _2330_2317) -> real ReplicationGate -> create_promotion_request -> registry-shaped entry -> runtime snapshot with two members with different baselines; decaying member flagged while a combined series looks healthy; negative cases for unapproved, wrong tenant/checksum/universe/child, missing run/lineage/metrics, failed gate, incomparable basis; production-path integration builds the service with no injected run reader (env-pointed owner store file) and asserts two members with different baselines get real deltas, the decaying one below baseline while the combined series is healthy; unit tests hand-compute the gate-basis replay and cover missing/failed/foreign run proof

validation.command: /tmp/persona-portfolio-venv/bin/python -m pytest test_persona_strategy_pool, test_approved_baselines, test_member_virtual_book, test_portfolio_envelope_parity, test_paper_runtime, test_runtime_summary_projection, test_performance_telemetry
validation.result: 300 passed, 69 subtests, exit 0 across the seven files

remaining_gaps: Gate-basis replay is a pure-python replica of the vectorbt from_orders path (vectorbt not installed in the worker venv); it is hand-checked, not diffed against a live vectorbt run. Short-side margin limits are not modelled (only buy cash cap).

Deployment gap: runtime/control-plane containers must mount the research owner's alpha-replication data dir (backtest_runs.json) and set ALPHA_REPLICATION_DATA_DIR; compose files are out of scope, so until then production members report backtest_run_binding_unavailable.
Tests use recorded fixtures, no hosted market-day claim. Autonomous member actions remain with EVOLUTION-POOL-MEMBER-ACTIONS and POOL-ADMISSION-AND-WEIGHTS.
